SVA18A-01.why: Tepid is a mild degree of heat and searing an extreme degree of the same quality; pricey is mildly expensive and exorbitant is extremely expensive.

SVA18A-02.why: To chide is to scold mildly and to berate is to scold harshly; to urge is to press mildly and to coerce is to press by force.

SVA18A-03.why: Reverence is an intense degree of esteem; rapture is an intense degree of satisfaction.

SVA18A-04.why: Domineering is the excessive, negative extreme of assertive; finicky is the excessive, negative extreme of selective.

SVA18A-05.why: Graze is a light contact and wallop a heavy blow; singe is a light burn and incinerate a total burn.

SVA18A-06.why: A tiff is a slight quarrel and a vendetta a prolonged, intense feud; a smattering is slight knowledge of a language and fluency full command of it.

SVA18A-07.why: Glum is mild sadness and despondent extreme sadness; peeved is mild anger and livid extreme anger.

SVA18A-08.why: Sniffle is mild crying and bawl intense crying; disappoint is a mild emotional blow and devastate an overwhelming one.

SVA18A-09.why: Artless means lacking guile; insipid means lacking flavor.

SVA18A-10.why: Callow means lacking maturity; insolvent means lacking funds.

SVA18A-11.why: Amorphous means lacking form; inert means lacking motion.

SVA18A-12.why: Tactless means lacking discretion; intrepid means lacking fright.

SVA18A-13.why: Unscrupulous means lacking principles; uncouth means lacking refinement.

SVA18A-14.why: Unkempt means lacking grooming; groundless means lacking a basis.

SVA18A-15.why: Pallid means lacking color; callous means lacking sympathy.

SVA18A-16.why: Dispirited means lacking morale; unwitting means lacking awareness.

SVA18A-17.why: A curmudgeon is by definition grouchy; a busybody is by definition meddlesome.

SVA18A-18.why: A stoic is by definition impassive; a maverick is by definition independent.

SVA18A-19.why: A renegade is by definition disloyal; a snob is by definition condescending.

SVA18A-20.why: A fatalist is characteristically passive (accepting fate); a perfectionist is characteristically exacting.

SVA18A-21.why: An introvert is characteristically reticent; a pushover is characteristically compliant.

SVA18A-22.why: A visionary is by definition farsighted; a dupe is by definition unsuspecting.

SVA18A-23.why: An extrovert is by definition outgoing; an egotist is by definition conceited.

SVA18A-24.why: A partisan is by definition biased; a purist is characteristically unbending about standards.

SVA18A-25.why: A connoisseur is by definition discerning; a skinflint is by definition tightfisted.

SVA18A-26.why: To lope is to run in a particular (easy, long-striding) manner; to smirk is to smile in a particular (smug) manner.

SVA18A-27.why: To pilfer is to steal in a specific way (petty amounts); to hurl is to throw in a specific way (forcefully).

SVA18A-28.why: To gobble is to eat in a specific (greedy, fast) manner; to glower is to look in a specific (angry) manner.

SVA18A-29.why: To sob is to cry in a specific (convulsive) manner; to jostle is to push in a specific (rough, crowded) manner.

SVA18A-30.why: A snicker is a laugh done in a specific (sly, suppressed) way; to slouch is to stand in a specific (drooping) way.

SVA18A-31.why: To quaff is to drink in a specific (hearty) manner; to drawl is to speak in a specific (slow, drawn-out) manner.

SVA18A-32.why: To cower is to crouch in a specific way (in fear); to yank is to pull in a specific way (sharply).

SVA18A-33.why: To stomp is to tread in a specific (heavy) way; to swat is to strike in a specific (quick, flat-handed) way.

SVA18A-34.why: To clutch is to grasp in a specific (tight) manner; to jab is to poke in a specific (sharp, quick) manner.

SVA18A-35.why: A pacifist abstains on principle from combat; a teetotaler abstains on principle from liquor.

SVA18A-36.why: A vegetarian rejects meat on principle; an isolationist rejects alliances on principle.

SVA18A-37.why: An ascetic rejects luxury on principle; an abolitionist rejects (opposes) slavery on principle.

SVA18A-38.why: A minimalist rejects clutter by conviction; a vegan rejects dairy by conviction.

SVA18A-39.why: A puritan rejects frivolity as a matter of belief; an atheist rejects a deity as a matter of belief.

SVA18A-40.why: An anarchist rejects hierarchy on principle; a freethinker rejects dogma on principle.

SVA18A-41.why: An objector opposes conscription on principle; an egalitarian opposes privilege on principle.

SVA18A-42.why: An iconoclast attacks tradition on principle; a rationalist rejects superstition on principle.

SVA18A-43.why: A pretext is a false reason offered in place of the real one; an alias is a false name used in place of the real one.

SVA18A-44.why: Bravado is a show of nerve that is not genuine; a feint is a show of attack that is not genuine.

SVA18A-45.why: Quackery is a fraudulent pretense of healing; hypocrisy is a fraudulent pretense of morality.

SVA18A-46.why: A veneer is a superficial show of sophistication without substance; lip service is a superficial show of commitment without substance.

SVA18A-47.why: A travesty is a sham imitation of justice; a placebo is a sham imitation of medication.

SVA18A-48.why: Tokenism is a nominal, merely-for-show version of integration; a figurehead is a nominal, merely-for-show leader.

SVA18A-49.why: A mirage is an illusory, false appearance of an oasis; pseudoscience is a false imitation of science.

SVA18A-50.why: Glib is a shallow, insincere counterfeit of articulate; sanctimonious is a shallow, insincere counterfeit of righteous.

SVA18B-01.why: A decoy is a thing whose purpose is to beguile; an alibi is a thing whose purpose is to exonerate.

SVA18B-02.why: A mnemonic exists to aid recall; an epitaph exists to memorialize.

SVA18B-03.why: A subpoena is designed to compel; satire is designed to deride.

SVA18B-04.why: A blockade is used to isolate; a bluff is used to hoodwink.

SVA18B-05.why: A pseudonym serves to secure anonymity; a chaperone serves to secure respectability (propriety).

SVA18B-06.why: A census is an official procedure carried out for enumeration; an audit is an official procedure carried out for verification.

SVA18B-07.why: A manifesto exists to proclaim; a tribunal exists to adjudicate.

SVA18B-08.why: A buttress is built to reinforce; a tariff is imposed to cushion (protect) domestic producers.

SVA18B-09.why: Complacency causes stagnation; mismanagement causes a deficit.

SVA18B-10.why: Tyranny provokes insurrection in those subjected to it; condescension provokes umbrage in those subjected to it.

SVA18B-11.why: Conceit leads to its consequence, a comeuppance; procrastination leads to its consequence, a backlog.

SVA18B-12.why: Secrecy breeds mistrust; impunity breeds lawlessness.

SVA18B-13.why: Infighting causes deadlock; ambiguity causes misunderstanding.

SVA18B-14.why: Austerity causes restiveness; favoritism causes acrimony.

SVA18B-15.why: Prodigality leads to destitution; idleness leads to delinquency.

SVA18B-16.why: Drudgery causes weariness; notoriety brings on scrutiny.

SVA18B-17.why: A wince is a facial reaction expressing hurt; a gape is a facial reaction expressing astonishment.

SVA18B-18.why: A yawn signals ennui; drumming (fingers) signals impatience.

SVA18B-19.why: A hoot expresses derision; a moan expresses suffering.

SVA18B-20.why: A pout expresses petulance; a strut expresses self-importance.

SVA18B-21.why: A frown expresses dissatisfaction; prostration expresses submission.

SVA18B-22.why: A swagger expresses cockiness; a slump expresses dejection.

SVA18B-23.why: An ovation expresses approbation; booing expresses disfavor.

SVA18B-24.why: Recoiling expresses repugnance; blanching expresses shock.

SVA18B-25.why: Antivenom counteracts an existing toxin; consolation counteracts (eases) existing misery.

SVA18B-26.why: A sedative relieves agitation; humor relieves tension.

SVA18B-27.why: A lozenge remedies hoarseness; a retraction remedies libel.

SVA18B-28.why: An analgesic relieves an existing migraine; alms relieve existing privation.

SVA18B-29.why: Reassurance relieves apprehension; a poultice relieves inflammation.

SVA18B-30.why: Absolution removes existing guilt; fumigation removes an existing infestation.

SVA18B-31.why: An antacid remedies heartburn; amends remedy an affront.

SVA18B-32.why: Mediation remedies an existing impasse; restitution remedies an existing larceny.

SVA18B-33.why: Reconnaissance is the preparatory step before an offensive; tuning is the preparatory step before a recital.

SVA18B-34.why: Preheating is the preparatory step before baking; brainstorming is the preparatory step before composing.

SVA18B-35.why: Triage is the preliminary step that precedes surgery; negotiation is the preliminary step that precedes ratification.

SVA18B-36.why: Stretching is the preparatory step before calisthenics; registration is the preparatory step before voting.

SVA18B-37.why: Fueling is the preparatory stage before a launch; courtship is the preparatory stage before matrimony.

SVA18B-38.why: Screening is the preparatory step before admission; saddling is the preparatory step before riding.

SVA18B-39.why: Mustering is the preliminary stage before a march; fermentation is the preliminary stage before distillation.

SVA18B-40.why: Anesthesia is the preparatory step before an operation; lacing (skates) is the preparatory step before skating.

SVA18B-42.why: Default is a failure to honor the obligations of a mortgage; absconding is a failure to honor the obligations of bail.

SVA18B-43.why: Nepotism is a betrayal of the impartiality one is trusted with; embezzlement is a betrayal of the stewardship one is trusted with.

SVA18B-44.why: Strikebreaking is a betrayal of solidarity; jilting is a betrayal of a betrothal.

SVA18B-45.why: A relapse is a breach of abstinence; a splurge is a breach of a budget.

SVA18B-46.why: Partisanship is a violation of neutrality; dereliction is a violation (failure) of duty.

SVA18B-47.why: Doping is a violation of sportsmanship; insubordination is a violation of obedience.

SVA18B-48.why: Infringement is a violation of a patent; snooping is a violation of privacy.

SVA18B-49.why: Inoculation averts an outbreak before it happens; foresight averts a calamity before it happens.

SVA18B-50.why: Diplomacy is a measure that prevents warfare before it starts; sandbagging is a measure that prevents overflow before it starts.
